  • Comissionamentode novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.


Quem você é:

Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

  • Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
  • Ter no mínimo 6anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
  • Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
  • Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
  • Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
  • Disponibilidadepara viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
  • Disponibilidadepara trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
  • Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.

Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:

Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.

Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass);
seguro de vida;
cooperativa de crédito;
previdência privada;
reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

Descrição da Empresa A Outlet de Ouro trabalha com peças em ouro 18k de segunda mão e joias de grandes grifes e alto padrão, em um processo que se inicia com compra de ouro, passa pela manutenção das joias em oficina e termina na exposição e venda das peças via Instagram e E-Commerce. (@outletdeouro).

Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um fotógrafo e filmmaker freelancer para algumas funções mistas, mas todas interligadas no processo da loja. A necessidade que identificamos é ter alguém conosco pelo menos 2 dias na semana, uma vez que temos como demandas principais o seguinte: 1. Tirar fotos e vídeos de mais de 50 novas joias por semana, incluindo diferentes ângulos para a mesma joia;
2. A fotografia e gravação de videos profissionais em estúdio com nossas modelos usando algumas das peças e 3. A criação de conteúdo criativo mobile, como stories de Instagram e Trends de Tiktok, de forma que a criatividade e proatividade são também fundamentais.   • Experience defining and applying architectural best practices for high availability, scalability, and performance.

title: Nurse Offshore
description:
Position: Nurse Offshore

Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias


About Us

MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.

For over 56 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.


Job Purpose

The Offshore Nurse is responsible for leading onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness, providing medical assistance, and promoting a healthy working environment and overall wellbeing for all personnel onboard the FPSO. The role also ensures compliance with corporate health standards and applicable regulations.


Key Responsibilities

Lead onboard health services, ensuring hospital readiness and proper medical assistance at all times;

Activate MEDEVAC procedures in accordance with remote medical support instructions;

Maintain updated inventory of medicines and medical supplies, ensuring availability and preventing expired items onboard;

Liaise with onshore remote medical support for diagnosis guidance and prescription of medicines for injured or ill personnel;

Support the preparation and implementation of rescue plans (confined space and working at height);

Request calibration, hydrostatic testing, and replacement of hospital equipment and first aid kits to ensure prompt emergency response;

Inspect catering services and facilities, including food storage, conservation, preparation, and accommodation cleanliness, maintaining proper health inspection records;

Participate in auditing and certification processes related to health services;

Collect and monitor fresh and potable water samples, conducting analysis onboard and coordinating onshore testing in accordance with procedures;

Provide First Aidtraining to designated first aid teams onboard;

Prepare and maintain medical documentation and reports (Health Initial Report, Logbook, corporate reports, and other required documents);

Implement and maintain the Health Service Waste Management Program and ensure proper recordkeeping.


Requirements

Degree in Nursing with valid COREN registration;

Previous experience in offshore operations (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);

Advanced life support and emergency care training;

Experience with occupational health routines and health surveillance;

Fluent English (minimum intermediate level);

Strong organizational skills and ability to work independently onboard;

Knowledge of Brazilian maritime and health regulations is an advantage.


Benefits

Meal and food allowances

Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)

Life Insurance

Annual Bonus

Private Pension Plan

Childcare Allowance


Note

This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.

MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

description:

Additional Information

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. title: Operador De Usv
description:
Sobre a TideWise

A TideWise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de Operadores de USV para integrar nossa equipe de operações. Esta é uma posição que une a experiência marítima tradicional com a fronteira da robótica. Você será responsável pela condução de embarcações não tripuladas em missões portuárias, costeiras e offshore, garantindo a continuidade operacional através de sistemas de controle remoto e autônomo.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

1. Operação do USV (Missão / ROC / Campo)

  • Operar o USV via Centro de Operações Remotas (ROC), assegurando a segurança da navegação, prontidão e cumprimento de limites operacionais.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de Survey (sonares e ROVs) para a perfeita execução da missão.
  • Executar watchkeeping remoto , mantendo consciência situacional total (tráfego, áreas restritas, aproximações e atracações) com aplicação prática de RIPEAM .
  • Realizar handover estruturado entre turnos (briefing/debriefing), garantindo rastreabilidade de status, pendências, registro de alarmes e decisões.


2. Planejamento, Checklists e Disciplina de Execução

  • Preparar e conduzir Planos de Navegação, Planos Operacionais e Checklists por missão e por embarcação.
  • Elaborar análise de riscos detalhada para as missões.
  • Diagnóstico Técnico: Diferente de um oficial convencional, você deve identificar falhas em sistemas críticos (propulsão, geradores, link de comunicação) interpretando logs e alarmes, coordenando ações com a equipe de manutenção.
  • Realizar validações críticas (energia, arrefecimento, propulsão, comandos, sensores essenciais e comunicações) antes de assumir missões.
  • Preencher e emitir DPR (Daily Progress Report) para todas as operações.


3. Manobras e Modos de Operação

  • Conduzir transições entre modos de trânsito e Posicionamento Dinâmico (DP) , decidindo a troca de modo por condições ambientais ou objetivo de missão.
  • Apoiar rotinas de convés: amarração, mobilização/desmobilização, reboque e verificações de prontidão de navegação.


4. Segurança, Contingência e Cibernética

  • Executar avaliação dinâmica de risco e garantir conformidade com o sistema de gestão (reporte de incidentes e "quase acidentes").
  • Operar sob procedimentos de contingência : quebra de ciclo, perda de sinal/controle, retorno seguro e falha segura.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança cibernética operacional (segregação de redes, controle de acesso e disciplina de uso de equipamentos).


5. Registros e Evidências

  • Produzir relatórios diários: linha do tempo, consumo, performance, alarmes e parâmetros exigidos por clientes.
  • Consolidar evidências para auditorias e lições aprendidas (limitações identificadas e recomendações de evolução).


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Aquaviário do 1º Grupo (Marítimo) – Seção de Convés: Oficial de Náutica (ON) ou CTR (Nível 5+) .
  • Certificações: STCW válidos e compatíveis (II/3, II/5 e IV/2 - Rádio-Operador).
  • Experiência Prática: Navegação de embarcações de pequeno porte (menor que 20m e propulsão com dois eixos).
  • Navegação em regiões de alta densidade de tráfego não controlado (pesca e recreio).
  • Vivência em ambiente offshore/portuário e rotinas de convés.
  • Tecnologia: Experiência prévia com operações remotas (COR/ROC ), VTS/VTMIS ou sistemas não tripulados (USV/ROV/UAV ).
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Experiência com mobilização, integração de sensores, testes e comissionamento básico.
  • Idiomas: Inglês instrumental (leitura de manuais, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica).


Perfil Comportamental (Soft Skills)

  • Disciplina operacional e rigor com normas/procedimentos.
  • Consciência situacional sob carga cognitiva e tomada de decisão sob pressão.
  • Comunicação clara, padronizada e fraseologia operacional (VHF).
  • Trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar, ética e integridade.


O Que Oferecemos

  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos inovadores e de alto impacto na indústria marítima e robótica.
  • Ambiente colaborativo e em constante evolução tecnológica.
  • Contato direto com todas as etapas do desenvolvimento, da concepção à operação real.
  • Salário e benefícios compatíveis com o mercado.


Junte-se à TideWise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo! ⚡⚓

title: Master Data Modeler
description:
Position Summary and Location

Support the design, development, and maintenance of master data models that ensure the accuracy and consistency of key business data across systems. Collaborate with senior team members to model data structures and optimize data flow, supporting various departments such as finance, sales, and operations. This position is ideal for someone with a passion for data modeling, a keen eye for detail, and a desire to grow in data management and governance.


Duties and Responsibilities

  • Assist in the design and development of master data models for master domains such as customer, assets, supplier, and financial data.
  • Help create and maintain data models (conceptual, logical, and physical) that align with business needs and data governance policies.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of master data by supporting data modeling standards and best practices.
  • Analyze data from various sources to support data modeling decisions and validate the accuracy and completeness of master data.
  • Perform basic data profiling and quality checks to identify patterns, anomalies, and potential improvements in data structures.
  • Collaborate with data quality and data governance teams to ensure consistency across systems.
  • Assist in designing data flow diagrams and documenting data mappings between different systems.
  • Work with data engineers and system architects to integrate master data models with existing databases and applications.
  • Support the creation of data management workflows that optimize data retrieval, storage, and reporting processes.
  • Help maintain documentation for master data models, including data definitions, relationships, and lineage.
  • Prepare reports and presentations on data modeling findings and recommendations to stakeholders and team members.
  • Contribute to the development of metadata repositories and data dictionaries to support enterprise data governance.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in data management, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Relevant coursework or project experience in data modeling, databases, or data management is a plus.
  • Basic understanding of data modeling concepts (e.G., entity-relationship models, dimensional modeling) and database structures.
  • Familiarity with data modeling tools such as Erwin, IBM InfoSphere Data Architect, SAP PowerDesigner, or similar tools.
  • Proficiency in SQL for querying databases and understanding relational data structures.
  • Some exposure to data governance principles, master data management (MDM), and data integration processes.


Desired Qualifications

  • Hands-on project experience in data modeling, data management, or database design.
  • Experience working with relational database management systems (RDBMS) such as Oracle, SQL Server, or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with metadata management and data dictionary tools is a plus.


Location: This position can be located in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói or Macaé.


This opportunity covers disabled or rehabilitated people.

title: Consultor(A) Comercial
description:
Junte-se à Robert Half e transforme carreiras e negócios.


Na Robert Half, estamos em constante evolução e buscamos Consultores(as) Comerciais com perfil consultivo, capazes de atuar em vendas complexas, de alto valor agregado , conectando desafios estratégicos de clientes às melhores soluções em talentos.


Quem somos e o que fazemos


Nossa missão é impactar vidas e organizações, apoiando empresas na tomada de decisões críticas relacionadas a pessoas e crescimento, por meio de soluções especializadas em recrutamento, projetos e consultoria em talentos . Atuamos de forma próxima aos clientes, entendendo profundamente seus contextos de negócio, desafios e objetivos de longo prazo.

Oferecemos um ambiente inclusivo, dinâmico e orientado a performance, com forte investimento em desenvolvimento profissional, tecnologia e inteligência de mercado.

  • Cultura orientada a bem-estar, performance sustentável e desenvolvimento contínuo;
  • Programas estruturados de treinamento em vendas consultivas e liderança;
  • Investimento constante em tecnologia e inteligência artificial para apoiar decisões comerciais;
  • Programas globais de reconhecimento e incentivo;
  • Oportunidades reais de mobilidade e crescimento no Brasil e no exterior.


Suas responsabilidades


Como Consultor(a) Comercial, sua atuação será fortemente estratégica e consultiva, com foco em desenvolver negócios, estruturar soluções customizadas e construir parcerias de longo prazo . Suas principais responsabilidades incluem:


  • Prospecção ativa e desenvolvimento de novos clientes, com foco em vendas complexas e consultivas ;
  • Gestão de contas estratégicas e relacionamento com decisores e lideranças de diferentes níveis;
  • Diagnóstico profundo das necessidades dos clientes, traduzindo desafios de negócio em soluções de recrutamento e talentos;
  • Condução de negociações comerciais e gestão de contratos, considerando ciclos de venda mais longos e múltiplos stakeholders;
  • Atuação integrada com times de recrutamento, participando do desenho da estratégia de busca como diferencial da proposta de valor;
  • Acompanhamento do processo de contratação e garantia da entrega de valor ao cliente;
  • Análise de mercado, tendências e mapeamento competitivo para apoiar decisões comerciais;
  • Visitas a clientes e participação ativa em reuniões estratégicas.



Quem procuramos


Buscamos profissionais com perfil consultivo, visão de negócio e alta capacidade relacional, que tenham:


  • Experiência prévia em vendas B2B complexas ou consultivas;
  • Capacidade de atuar com múltiplos stakeholders e influenciar decisores;
  • Forte orientação a resultados, sem abrir mão de ética e qualidade na entrega;
  • Habilidade paraconstruir relações de confiança de longo prazo com clientes e candidatos;
  • Experiência prévia ou atuação próxima a processos de recrutamento e seleção será considerada um diferencial, mas não é um requisito obrigatório.
  • Pensamento analítico, curiosidade intelectual e capacidade de entender diferentes modelos de negócio;
  • Boa comunicação, presença executiva e habilidade de negociação;
  • Graduação completa;
  • Inglês avançado.


Nosso compromisso com a diversidade


Na Robert Half, acreditamos que diversidade de experiências, perspectivas e histórias fortalece nossos resultados. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, respeitoso e equitativo, onde cada pessoa pode ser quem é e atingir seu máximo potencial.

Se você busca uma posição comercial estratégica, com impacto real nos negócios dos clientes e na carreira das pessoas, venha construir o futuro com a Robert Half.

title: Advogada Controller Jurídico
description:
Vaga Afirmativa Advogada Controller Jurídico.


O Escritório Vila Nova e Brandão advogados ( é um escritório de pequeno porte, moderno e em franco crescimento, contrata advogada preta, formada há no máximo três anos, com carteira da OAB para o cargo de Advogada controller jurídico em trabalho presencial.


O cargo que estamos ofertando é para Advogada controller jurídico júnior, que é a profissional em início de carreira porém com experiência e autonomia para gerir os processos pelo qual será responsável, sempre supervisionada pelo advogado sênior do escritório. É uma função estratégica e de muita confiança.


A Advogada Controller Jurídico é a profissional responsável por garantir que os processos do escritório caminhem com organização, previsibilidade e segurança técnica. É ela quem acompanha diariamente os prazos, movimentações processuais e demandas extrajudiciais (cartórios, RGIs, Certidões, etc), assegurando que nenhuma providência passe despercebida, que as peças sejam produzidas em tempo oportuno e que as rotinas do escritório fluam com eficiência. Atua como ponto central entre os advogados, os sistemas eletrônicos, os cartórios e os clientes, organizando informações, prevenindo riscos, padronizando procedimentos e contribuindo ativamente para a qualidade e a estratégia do trabalho jurídico desenvolvido. Mais do que controlar prazos, a Controller é a guardiã da gestão dos processos e da excelência operacional do escritório.


O cargo requer profundo conhecimento e habilidade nos sistemas de processo eletrônico (DPC/TJRJ, PJE, E-Saj, E-Proc, etc), além de conhecimento nos sistemas extrajudiciais RI - Digital e Emissão de Certidões.


Para o preenchimento da vaga a profissional, além de ser formada em direito, tem que ser uma pessoa proativa, ter bom humor, brilho nos olhos, ter raciocínio lógico, saber usar os programas básicos do computador e ter disposição para aprender e operar os sistemas utilizados pelo escritório.


Qualificações

Inscrição na Ordem dos Advogados do Brasil;
proativa, excelente redação, e escrita fluida, desembaraçada, espírito de equipe e inovadora;
ser muito organizada;
ser muito responsável e comprometida;
gostar de rotina;
ser eloquente;
estar aberta a aprender;
Comunicativa e gostar de trabalhar em grupo. É desejável que tenha experiência prévia nas áreas de controladoria jurídica e advocacia extrajudicial cível, imobiliária e sucessória através de estágios e ou exercício da advocacia.


Requisitos para ocupação do cargo:

1 - Ensino superior em Direito;

2 - Inscrição na OAB;

3 - Experiência de 2 anos, conhecimento básico em gestão de processos jurídicos;

4 - Controle de prazos - Desejável habilidade no sistema ASTREA;

5 -Conhecimento e prática nos sistemas de processo eletrônico (DPC/TJRJ, PJE, E-Saj, E-Proc, etc), além ddos sistemas extrajudiciais RI - Digital e Emissão de Certidões

6 - Conhecimento técnico em procedimentos extrajudiciais (inventários, usucapião judicial e extrajudicial, adjudicação compulsória, compra e venda, testamentos, doações, procurações, etc;

7 - Habilidade em interagir com cartórios de notas, títulos e documentos, e cartórios registrais;

8 - Capacidade de identificar problemas nos processos e sugerir melhorias para aumentar a eficiência;

9 - Atuado no mínimo 1 ano de experiência no setor de controladoria jurídica;

10 -Facilidade no uso de inteligências artificiais (Gemini, Chatgpt, NotebookLM)


Trabalho Presencial no Centro do Rio de Janeiro


Carga horária: 8hs diárias, mais intervalo de uma hora para refeições de segunda a sexta-feira (09h às 18h)

Benefícios: plano de saúde, vale refeição, vale transporte

Comprometimento e maturidade;

Facilidade na comunicação com clientes, ser desembaraçada;
ter proatividade, espírito de equipe e inovador.

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to design, build, and maintain innovative applications and platforms that drive business success and improve patient outcomes.


Primary Responsibilities:

  • Platform Development: Spearhead the development and optimization of our EHR platform using PHP/Laravel, ensuring high performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Database Development: Creating database schemas that represent and support business processes
  • API Development and Integration: Develop and maintain APIs for internal and external use, facilitating seamless integration with other healthcare systems and third-party services.
  • Security Compliance: Ensure the platform's compliance with healthcare industry standards, including HIPAA, by implementing and maintaining robust security measures and data protection protocols.


Additional Responsibilities:

  • Mentor junior developers, providing guidance on best practices in backend development, code review, and team collaboration.
  • Stay abreast of new technology trends and evaluate their application to continually innovate and enhance the platform.
  • Participate in the agile development process, contributing to sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software.
  • Collaborate with the design team to refine the platform's user interface and experience, implementing responsive and intuitive front-end functionalities using modern JavaScript frameworks.


Competencies/Requirements:

  • Technical Expertise: Strong proficiency in PHP/Laravel and MySQL. Familiarity with version control tools, preferably Git.
  • Experience: At least 5 years of experience in backend development, with a proven track record of developing and maintaining scalable web applications. Experience in the healthcare sector or EHR platforms is highly desirable.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Ability to tackle complex problems, think analytically, and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of effectively collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Attention to Detail: A strong focus on code quality, adherence to design specifications, and a commitment to creating a user-friendly, secure, and efficient platform.


Benefits:

  • Competitive salary to recognise and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Human Resources Analyst
description:
Remote HR & Investigation ASSISTANT, HR & Investigation ANALYST and HR & Investigation SPECIALIST Positions. (Effective February 1, 2026)

This document describes three separate positions: HR & Investigation Assistant, HR & Investigation Analyst, and HR & Investigation Specialist. Individuals are hired into one position based on qualifications and experience. CLS offers a structured internal advancement path;
however, progression isperformance-based and not automatic.


Ask Yourself...

1. Do you live in BRAZIL and possess advanced professional communication skills in English, both verbal and written?

2. Do you love to read, write, and analyze things?

3. Are you a detailed and accurate notetaker?

4. Can you type both fast and accurately?

6. Do you seek to develop your leadership skills and build a career related to Human Resources and Labor Law?

7. Would you describe yourself as someone who has a strong eye for detail?

8. Do you have experience working independently and managing your time effectively in a home office setting?

9. Are you a curious person with an analytical mind who is engaged by analyzing complex workplace complaints and evidence in employee discrimination and harassment investigations.

10. Are you someone who thrives in environments that offer continuous change, challenge, learning, and growth opportunities?

If you answered YES to all the above questions, this may be the perfect opportunity for you to join our amazing team!

About California Labor Solutions:

California Labor Solutions (CLS) is a growing workplace investigation and human resource (HR) management company located in California, USA. CLS provides HR services, such as consulting, executive search/recruitment, and employee complaint investigations, to other organizations throughout California. We help organizations become more successful by strategically supporting them to manage their workforce and the relevant employment regulations.

Role Overview:

You will assist the Principal Workplace Investigator with:

· Preparing witness interview questions.

· Creating accurate and complete witness interview notes/summaries.

· Drafting and copywriting comprehensive workplace investigation reports utilizing analytical skills and an advanced level of organization, precision, and attention to accuracy.

· Communicating findings effectively.

· Performing other workplace investigation-related tasks efficiently.

· Supporting other HR-related projects, such as executive search/recruitment.

Regardless of your academic background, this is a unique opportunity to build your human resources career.


Qualifications & Requirements:

Assistant, Analyst, and Specialist are three separate roles. Candidates are hired into one role based on qualifications, and promotion is performance-based and not automatic.

Human Resources & Investigation ASSISTANT position:

· Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

· A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional work experience (in any field) is required. This experience must have been conducted primarily in English. Internship experience does not count.

· A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

· A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required.


Human Resources & Investigation ANALYST position:

· Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

· A minimum of 2 years of full-time professional human resources related work experience in English OR a minimum of 4 years of professional work experience in English (in any field) is required. (Work experience in an internship does not count.) A minimum of 1 year of experience working in a full-time job remotely with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

· A Professional Bachelor’s Degree in any field is required. A master’s degree is preferred.

· A minimum of 1 year of experience drafting employee disciplinary documents or conducting serious employee complaint investigations is preferred.

Human Resources & Investigation SPECIALIST position:

· Advanced professional English speaking and writing skills are required.

· A minimum of 5 years of full-time professional human resources related work experience conducted in English is required . (Internship experience does not count.) A minimum of one (1) year of experience working in a full-time remote job with a defined schedule from a home office is required.

· A professional bachelor’s degree in any field is required. A master’s degree is preferred.

· A minimum of 1 year of experience drafting employee disciplinary documents or conducting serious employee complaint investigations is required.

· A minimum of 1 year of experience supervising employees (not just leading) is required . Experience supervising three (3) or more employees for at least one (1) year is preferred .

Amazing Compensation, Benefits, Incentives, and Bonuses:

HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ASSISTANT (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $3,500 BRL to $5,000 BRL million COP. The total compensation amount already includes benefits, which are valued as follows:

· Gym membership support: $105 BRL

· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL


Starting monthly base compensation ranges between $3,500 BRL to $4,200 BRL, depending on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. You may also qualify for bonuses. Please see below for a list of additional compensation opportunities. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until it reaches the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Assistant for a minimum of 6 months with consistently competent performance and become eligible for promotion to the HR & Investigation Analyst position.


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION ANALYST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $5,000 BRL to $7,700 BRL. The total compensation amount already includes benefits, which are valued as follows:

· Gym membership support: $105 BRL

· Private health insurance support: $265 BRL

· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support: $160 BRL

Starting monthly base compensation ranges between $5,000 BRL to $6,300 BRL, depending on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs AND possession of both required and preferred qualifications. You may also qualify for bonuses. Please see below for a list of additional compensation opportunities. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and a compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until you reach the maximum compensation range for the position. Work as a CLS HR & Investigation Analyst for a minimum of 12 months with competent and consistent performance and become eligible for promotion to the Specialist position.


HUMAN RESOURCES & INVESTIGATION SPECIALIST (Position Open Now): The total monthly compensation range is $7,700 BRL to $10,000 BRL. The total compensation amount already includes benefits, which are valued as follows:

· Gym membership support : $105 BRL

· Private health insurance support : $265 BRL

· Home office and phone/high-speed internet service support : $160 BRL

The starting monthly compensation is $7,700 BRL to $9,000 BRL, depending on the level and quality of your work experience relevant to the work CLS performs, as well as your ability to meet both the required and preferred qualifications for the role. You may also qualify for bonuses. Please see below for a list of additional compensation opportunities. Every six months, you will receive a performance review and a compensation increase of up to $700 BRL, depending on your performance, until you reach the maximum compensation range for the position.


Additional Compensation & High-Performance Bonus Opportunities includes:

· High-performance bonus: When you perform investigation work, every case that you complete from start to finish in accordance with CLS protocols and without major errors will earn you a bonus of $700 BRL. That is $700 BRL for the person assisting the Investigator AND another $700 BRL for the senior writer (the person co-leading the project and performing the final review). Once you become “certified” to produce accurate and complete witness interview summaries (typically within your first 3 months at CLS), the bonus increases to $1,400 BRL per investigation.

Core Hours for Operations:

Core hours of operation are Monday through Friday from 6:00 a.M. to 4:00 p.M. PST / 7:00 a.M. to 5:00 p.M. PDT, California, USA time, with the potential to earn extra pay for extended hours or weekend contributions for high-impact projects.

A pessoa contratada atuará como prestadora de serviços criativos, desenvolvendo peças de motion design em colaboração com a equipe de criação. A atuação será orientada por briefings e diretrizes estratégicas, preservando autonomia técnica na execução.

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (Zos) - Home Office
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location : Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps;
    deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant Saas)
description:
Our US-based client is looking for a full-time, remote Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS) with 7+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the backend services and integrations that enable secure, scalable, multi-tenant embedded analytics within a SaaS platform.


This role sits at the intersection of application engineering, identity management, and the data platform. The primary focus is on integrating embedded analytics tools into a multi-tenant application with strict tenant isolation, SSO-based access control, and high-concurrency usage patterns.

While AWS QuickSight is the primary BI platform, we are open to candidates with experience embedding other modern, multi-tenant analytics solutions (such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, or Superset). The emphasis is on a strong understanding of how embedded analytics work in SaaS environments, rather than on expertise in a single tool.

This is a senior-level role with meaningful influence over analytics architecture, security considerations, and integration standards across the platform.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-tenant embedded analytics within customer-facing SaaS applications
  • Build backend services that generate and manage embed sessions, URLs, and permissions dynamically per tenant and user
  • Implement SSO and identity propagation (Auth0, Cognito, OIDC) to enforce tenant-aware access and role-based controls
  • Ensure row-level and dataset-level security is consistently applied across embedded analytics experiences
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers to align datasets, semantic models, and RLS logic with application roles
  • Translate analytics platform constraints into clean, reliable application-facing abstractions
  • Design and maintain tenant-aware APIs that abstract analytics tools behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build service-layer patterns that isolate application code from direct BI or warehouse dependencies
  • Implement caching, pagination, throttling, and batching strategies for high-concurrency analytics traffic
  • Ensure APIs gracefully handle tenant onboarding/offboarding and evolving analytics assets
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design scalable backend patterns supporting hundreds of tenants
  • Optimize service-to-warehouse and service-to-analytics-tool interactions for latency and cost efficiency
  • Identify and mitigate failure modes in embedded analytics workflows (timeouts, permission drift, stale sessions)
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, integration diagrams, and design reviews
  • Enforce least-privilege access and tenant isolation across all analytics integrations
  • Ensure compliance with PII, data governance, and audit requirements in embedded reporting flows
  • Implement logging and audit trails for analytics access and permission changes
  • Partner with InfoSec to support security reviews and compliance initiatives
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for integration services and analytics-related configuration
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability through CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Improve operational reliability through monitoring, alerting, and runbook development
  • Act as a technical owner for embedded analytics integrations
  • Partner with Product to shape analytics capabilities and roadmap decisions
  • Mentor mid-level engineers on integration patterns, security, and service design
  • Drive standards for analytics integration consistency and developer experience


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in SaaS environments
  • Strong experience building backend services in Node.Js, Python, or PHP
  • Hands-on experience embedding analytics or BI tools into multi-tenant applications
  • Strong understanding of SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and identity propagation
  • Experience implementing tenant-aware access controls (RLS, role mapping, dataset isolation)
  • Solid SQL knowledge and experience integrating with data warehouses
  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment (AWS or equivalent)


Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Experience embedding AWS QuickSight in multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Experience with other embedded analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Superset, Mode, etc.)
  • Familiarity with row-level security models and permission orchestration
  • Experience with Auth0 or Cognito in analytics contexts.
  • Knowledge of caching layers (Redis) and high-concurrency API design
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, or analytics access auditing


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Grc (Governance, Risk And Compliance) Systems Administrator
description:
Job Title: GRC (Governance, Risk and Compliance) Systems Administrator

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 10+ months (Possibility of Extension)

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Work Hours: PST

Location: 100% Remote - (Candidates can work from anywhere in LATAM Countries)


Team Overview

The GRC Systems team provides the technology foundation that supports long-running, human-driven Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) processes. The team delivers authoritative data and scalable tools that enable partners across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to reason effectively, make informed decisions, and answer complex compliance questions.

We focus on deeply understanding user workflows and eliminating manual effort by stitching fragmented experiences into seamless, end-to-end journeys.


Role Overview

As a GRC Systems Administrator , you will serve as the primary service owner for AuditBoard and Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) . This role bridges business process and technical configuration, ensuring GRC platforms are not only stable and reliable, but continuously evolving to meet organizational complexity and growth.


You will operate in a Build and Run model—leading new configurations and enhancements while also owning day-to-day system administration, user access, and vendor management. You will work closely with Audit, Risk, and Compliance stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable low-code/no-code solutions that improve efficiency and user experience.


Key Responsibilities

Platform Administration & Configuration

  • Own the daily administration of AuditBoard and Archer Evolv, including configuration of modules, workflows, fields, layouts, notifications, and automation.
  • Ensure system stability, data integrity, and optimal performance across platforms.
  • Manage complex role-based access control (RBAC), user permissions, and access governance to ensure appropriate data visibility.


Stakeholder Partnership

  • Engage regularly with internal users across Audit, Risk, and Compliance to gather feedback and identify friction points.
  • Translate ambiguous or evolving business requirements into clear, actionable system configurations and improvements.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders on platform capabilities and best practices.


Vendor & Service Ownership

  • Serve as the primary technical point of contact for GRC platform vendors.
  • Manage vendor relationships, support tickets, escalations, and service delivery commitments.
  • Advocate for platform enhancements and roadmap priorities aligned with business needs.


Project Delivery

  • Plan and manage multiple concurrent configuration initiatives, including new module rollouts, regulatory standards onboarding, and process enhancements.
  • Drive projects end-to-end—from requirements gathering and design through testing, deployment, and user enablement.


Documentation & Enablement

  • Maintain clear, up-to-date documentation for system configurations and administrative processes.
  • Develop user guides, training materials, and release notes to support adoption of new features and workflows.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in systems administration or SaaS platform administration
  • Deep hands-on experience with AuditBoard or comparable GRC SaaS platforms
  • Experience administering Archer Evolv (Compliance.AI) or similar Regulatory Change Management solutions
  • Strong proficiency in low-code/no-code configuration within enterprise SaaS tools
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders and translate loosely defined business problems into concrete technical solutions
  • Experience managing vendor relationships, including support escalations and feature advocacy


Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with REST API concepts and SaaS integrations (e.G., integrations with Jira, Slack, or identity providers)
  • Relevant certifications (e.G., AuditBoard Certified Administrator or similar)
  • Experience working in agile environments with two-week sprint cycles
  • Background in high-growth or fast-scaling organizations where processes are still being defined

title: Privacy Counsel (Full Time, Remote Position)
description:
About VeraSafe:

VeraSafe is an innovative and successful U.S. headquartered privacy and cybersecurity compliance consulting firm and law firm. Due to rapid growth and increased demand for our international privacy and technology compliance and legal services, VeraSafe is seeking creative, motivated, and collaborative attorneys to join our team, regardless of prior work experience or education background. This is a fully remote position and will remain a fully remote position.


Watch / listen to learn more about VeraSafe: Check out our podcast!

Apple Podcast :

YouTube :

Spotify:


VeraSafe is proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work©, with 96% of our employees affirming that we are truly a great place to work . This means we foster trust, collaboration, and a positive work environment. We are committed to maintaining this standard of meaningful work, work-life balance, and a supportive community. Check out our great benefits, listed at the end of this job description.


VeraSafe frequently hires for attorney and consultant positions on a rolling basis. We are growing rapidly and seek to proactively build a strong talent pool to meet sustained, increasing client demand.


About the Role:

This is an excellent opportunity for an attorney with 4-6 years of experience who wants to join a team working on the cutting edge of privacy and data protection, and who wants to further develop a practice in an in-demand, high-tech area of law. We are inundated with business from clients who love the way we advise on privacy compliance (hence the need for you!).


While this role requires professional experience in privacy law , we are prepared to welcome you to our team with a robust and established onboarding and training process. We typically advance people more quickly than your typical law firm, and we do it on an individual basis (no lockstep promotions or compensation).


Note : We include skills assessments in the recruitment for this position. We know this is a burden, but we think it’s worth it, and we appreciate you taking the time to complete it. We’ve found it enables us to find the best attorneys, regardless of their experience, where they went to law school, or where they were trained. We want smart, kind, creative lawyers, plain and simple, and this assessment is a crucial part of our ability to hire this way.


We are not your typical legal job. We use project managers to keep our remote team organized and our projects streamlined and on-track. We encourage our team members to travel and to make use of our ability to work as digital nomads, whether that means spending a few months abroad or on extended trips to be near family. We collaborate closely (you won’t feel like you’re working in isolation) and we actively encourage sharing of credit for work well done, resources, and advice (and penalize the reverse). We are not biglaw. We do top-notch work for interesting clients, yet we pride ourselves on our team members being happy, with time and energy for a life outside of work, which we believe makes us better attorneys who don’t burn out.


The bottom line: If you want to learn or go deeper practicing privacy law, if you want to practice in a problem-solving environment focused on giving excellent and yet actionable advice, if you want to work with a global team of friendly, brilliant people, if you want the flexibility to work in a way that makes sense to you, please apply!


Responsibilities Include:

  • Assessing client information systems for compliance with data protection laws and regulations
  • Drafting data protection agreements, addenda, and amendments
  • Advising clients on privacy-related product improvements
  • Researching legal issues and composing legal opinions/memoranda
  • Writing privacy law related articles and blog posts
  • Assisting in the development of in-house legal templates
  • Contributing to the development of internal procedures and methodologies
  • Collaborating with a team of intellectual peers who value cooperation and community


What We Need From You

Need to Have:

  • License to practice law (active and in good standing) in your jurisdiction
  • Experience in privacy/data protection of 4-6 years or experience in the field of life sciences of at least 4 years
  • Team player, interested in contributing to a growing enterprise
  • Strong writing/editing skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work remotely
  • Willingness to learn new skills and receive direction and feedback from partners
  • Willingness to pursue privacy certifications (e.G., CIPP/E, CIPM)


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working in a law firm
  • Previous contract drafting and negotiation experience
  • Privacy certifications of some kind (e.G., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, specialty from law school, etc.)
  • Professional involvement in the privacy and/or data security space (attendance at privacy conferences;
    membership or publication in the IAPP, etc.)


Key Competencies:

  • Detail-oriented and highly organized with a strong work ethic
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable using a variety of software applications
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage your own schedule in order to work successfully with international teams and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently and fully deliver on all commitments


VeraSafe’s Excellent Benefits Include:

  • Work from almost anywhere with Wi-Fi
  • Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Paid holidays
  • Annual bonuses
  • Membership in the International Association of Privacy Professionals (IAPP) and IAPP exam fee reimbursement (CIPP/E)
  • Flexible working schedule in some roles
  • Reimbursement for certain personal flight ticket
  • Company laptop provided


Other Benefits:

  • Tremendous professional development growth opportunities in the privacy, data protection, and cybersecurity niche
  • The chance to have a long-lasting effect on a small but growing international business
  • Work in an open environment with a team that respects your ideas and contributions
  • Occasional opportunities to travel in North America and Europe

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.


We’re excited to be hiring a Talent Acquisition Specialist to help grow MAVI’s talent network from the hundreds today to millions in the years ahead. Talent acquisition is at the heart of MAVI’s platform, and we’re looking for someone who is creative, resourceful, and data-driven to help us build scalable ways of sourcing and vetting top finance talent across the globe.


You’ll be joining as one of the first dedicated members of our Talent Acquisition (TA) team, working closely with colleagues and founders to shape and expand our network. This is a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact, build processes from the ground up, and directly influence how we grow.


What You’ll Do:


  • Lead and support end-to-end talent acquisition.
  • Explore, establish, and refine channels for talent sourcing at scale across LATAM (primarily), APAC, and other regions, in close partnership with the engineering team.
  • Build proprietary sourcing networks in key regions, using creative strategies to attract exceptional talent.
  • Guide and improve the vetting process to ensure only the most qualified finance & accounting professionals join MAVI’s network.
  • Define and track key performance metrics for sourcing and vetting to continuously enhance processes and uphold high standards of quality.
  • Collaborate closely with the TA team, founders, and engineering team to introduce automation and efficiencies across sourcing, screening, and vetting.
  • Partner with the TA team and founders to shape the right distribution of skills and profiles in the talent pool, and source accordingly to meet these goals.
  • Consistently work towards meeting and surpassing monthly talent acquisition KPIs.
  • Act as a trusted thought partner to the founders on all aspects of talent acquisition.


What We’re Looking For:


  • 3-8+ years of end-to-end recruiting experience, with some leadership exposure being a plus.
  • Strong ability to source high-quality talent at scale using both active and passive techniques, ideally across multiple regions (with APAC and LATAM experience being especially valuable).
  • Skilled in vetting and interviewing talent, serving as an early filter to assess candidates against defined criteria.
  • Experience experimenting with and refining different sourcing channels and strategies.
  • Comfortable using data to guide sourcing and acquisition decisions, and setting KPIs to measure success.
  • Prior experience recruiting finance & accounting talent is a plus, though not essential.
  • Familiarity with key HR tools (e.G.,, job boards, ATS platforms) to support efficient acquisition processes.
  • Ability to thrive in dynamic, fast-moving environments, with flexibility to adapt to change.
  • Strong communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • A team player who is humble, driven, and passionate about delivering excellence in their work.


Why You Should Join Us:


  • Impact : You’re not just another cog in the machine;
    you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy : Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay : We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it.
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Isso faz parte do ciclo natural de uma cidade viva e em constante transformação. Mas acreditamos que esses resíduos podem ter um destino melhor — e possível — continuando a gerar valor e mantendo a vida em movimento.

Foi com esse propósito que nasceu a Regenera Rio .

Uma empresa dedicada a transformar a forma como o Rio de Janeiro lida com seus resíduos, provenientes de residências, comércios e indústrias, garantindo um destino ambientalmente adequado. Tudo pensado para que o ciclo do saneamento básico seja completo: do transporte ao tratamento.

Um movimento que impulsiona a economia local, apoia a geração de empregos diretos e indiretos, fortalece a cadeia da reciclagem e contribui para uma cidade mais limpa e sustentável.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil;
fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM;
and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a br Malls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a br Malls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.
Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuições:
Acompanhar de forma próxima a performance dos shoppings, com leitura aprofundada dos principais drivers de resultado;

Preparar materiais executivos e apoiar fóruns e apresentações para a Diretoria;
Atuar como referência analítica em performance e resultados, garantindo profundidade, consistência e qualidade das entregas.Requisitos e qualificações:

Ao ser alocado em uma de nossas demandas externas, você terá a oportunidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e desafiadores, colaborando diretamente para o sucesso de nossos clientes. Essa contribuição proporciona vivência prática e aprendizado constante. E você contará com o acompanhamento próximo da equipe Forvis Mazars, garantindo alinhamento ao longo de toda a sua atuação.
Responsabilidades e Atribuições:
Apoiar nos processos de conciliação contábil e revisão de provisões;
Realizar lançamentos contábeis e garantir a acuracidade das informações registradas;
Participar da elaboração e análise de demonstrações financeiras individuais e consolidadas;
Executar rotinas de fechamento contábil mensal, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos;
Atuar com apuração de tributos nos regimes de Lucro Real, Presumido e Simples Nacional;
Contribuir com a revisão de saldos e composição de contas patrimoniais, incluindo ativos;
Oferecer suporte às demais rotinas contábeis, garantindo alinhamento com as normas da empresa;
Ter proatividade e boa gestão do tempo, assegurando a entrega com qualidade e eficiência.
Requisitos e Qualificações:
Graduação em Ciências Contábeis;
Experiência prévia na área contábil com atuação em fechamento e conciliações;
Conhecimento em regimes tributários: Lucro Real, Presumido e Simples Nacional;
Capacidade analítica, atenção aos detalhes e boa comunicação;
Conhecimento intermediário em Excel e em sistemas de ERP (desejável SAP, Protheus, etc.).
O que esperamos de você
Comprometimento com prazos, entregas e qualidade do trabalho;
Capacidade de adaptação a diferentes ambientes e rotinas corporativas;
Proatividade na resolução de problemas e execução das atividades;
Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
Responsabilidade, organização e adaptabilidade;
Disposição para colaborar com diferentes equipes e projetos;
Benefícios
Rede de academias;
Canal de apoio psicológico;
Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
Vale Transporte;
Assistência Médica;
Assistência Odontológica;
Seguro de vida.
